$comment: The central narration render profile (docs/plans/spark-central-narration-assessment.md §3.2, rulings D1-D11 accepted 2026-09-28).
ONE file read by render-foray.py (how audio is made), upload-narration.mjs (where it goes, with which headers) and stamp-narration.mjs (what data/forays.json says).

EVERYTHING UNDER `render` IS HASHED INTO EVERY OBJECT KEY. Change any value there and every key changes, so a new render can never overwrite an old object (the bucket is write-once and phones keep old data sets). Bump `id` in the same edit so the new objects also land under a new prefix.
Fields outside `render` (voices, rejects, headers, bucket) do not change audio bytes and are not hashed.

The fp32 model and af_heart are pinned in tools/mobile/fetch-models.mjs (the one hash table). am_echo has no pin there yet (KV-01), so its sha256 is recorded here, equal to the #844 audition manifest and tools/narration/bench-narration.py RECORDED_VOICE_PINS; a pin in fetch-models.mjs wins once it exists.

render.chunking: phonemize.py sentence_chunks, one inference per chunk, style row len(ids)-2

loudness.method: ffmpeg loudnorm measures (pass 1); one gain to the target, then an alimiter peak limiter at the ceiling, at most max_reduction_db (pass 2); the ENCODED file's true peak is measured and, if over the target, re-encoded with the ceiling lowered by the overshoot + step_db (at most `attempts` encodes, then refused); never loudnorm's dynamic mode
loudness.note: -19 LUFS integrated on the mono file is -16 LUFS as heard on two speakers (assessment §3.2 / §7)

encode.encoder: ffmpeg native aac (LGPL build; never libfdk_aac)
